name: Subagent filesystem prompt injection
description: Read grouped filesystem drafts with continuous layer fallback and inject them before the delegated task.

layout.title: Filesystem prompt layout
layout.description: Define grouped prompt messages and ordered file layers. All entries in one group fall back together. [system] entries are emitted as user messages for Provider compatibility.
layout.default:
[group: cot]
[assistant]
# cot
[/draft/cot.md][1000]

[group: parts]
[assistant]
# part 1
[/draft/draft-1.md][1000]
[/output/output-1.md][1000]

[assistant]
# part 2
[/draft/draft-2.md][1000]
[/output/output-2.md][1000]

[assistant]
# part 3
[/draft/draft-3.md][1000]
[/output/output-3.md][1000]

[assistant]
# part 4
[/draft/draft-4.md][1000]
[/output/output-4.md][1000]
